product.name: Lucy
product.tagline: The shared skill store for Bending Spoons sellers.

_ignore_comment: Skills that come from somewhere other than Lucy. The beacon skips these entirely, so they never show up as 'not in the store'. Add to this list rather than letting the fleet page fill with noise.

prospecting-onboarding.title: Onboarding
prospecting-onboarding.summary: Sets Lucy up for you in about 20 minutes. Interviews you, writes your config, checks your connectors, builds your contact repository, and stages your first batch.
prospecting-onboarding.why: Start here. Everything else assumes this has run.
prospecting-onboarding.author: Kenny Fasehun

prospecting-engine.title: Prospecting Engine
prospecting-engine.summary: The daily motion. Screens accounts, stages a batch, drafts the outreach, logs every outcome. Runs a different sequence depending on whether you are a BDR, AE, or CSM.
prospecting-engine.why: This is the part that books meetings.
prospecting-engine.author: Kenny Fasehun

human-messaging.title: Human Messaging
human-messaging.summary: Writes the actual emails. Enforces a banned-phrase list and the one-question rule. Grounded in Gap Selling, Sandler, and Josh Braun rather than generic sales copy.
human-messaging.why: Run before drafting anything a prospect will read.
human-messaging.author: Kenny Fasehun

objection-handler.title: Objection Handler
objection-handler.summary: For when they say no. Researches the prospect's actual stack first, finds the real gap, then replies in a way that teaches something instead of begging for the meeting back.
objection-handler.why: A decline is usually timing, not a no.
objection-handler.author: Kenny Fasehun

followup-noshow.title: Follow-ups and No-shows
followup-noshow.summary: Nudges holds nobody has accepted, confirms today's meetings, and rebooks anyone who missed one. Never sends a naked reminder.
followup-noshow.why: A no-show is not a no.
followup-noshow.author: Kenny Fasehun

call-needs-assessment.title: Call Needs Assessment
call-needs-assessment.summary: After a call, pulls the transcript and maps every stated need against what you actually sell. Marks each one solved, partial, gap, or needs validation. Flags commercial and competitive risk.
call-needs-assessment.why: Stops you promising things the product does not do.
call-needs-assessment.author: Kenny Fasehun

warm-opener.title: Warm Opener
warm-opener.summary: Researches a prospect's public interests and location so the message opens with something real, a result, a local event, something they posted, before the business bit.
warm-opener.why: Warmth is the single biggest lift in the field data so far.
warm-opener.author: Kenny Fasehun

lucy-sync.title: Sync
lucy-sync.summary: Pulls the newest version of everything from the store and installs it. Tells you what changed and what you had edited locally before it touches anything.
lucy-sync.why: Say "sync lucy" whenever you want to be current.
lucy-sync.author: Kenny Fasehun

lucy-publish.title: Publish
lucy-publish.summary: Takes a skill you built, adds it to the store, packages it, and drafts the announcement. Refuses to publish anything containing contact data.
lucy-publish.why: If you built something good, this is how everyone else gets it.
lucy-publish.author: Kenny Fasehun

lucy-report.title: Report Card
lucy-report.summary: Counts your meetings booked and opps piped, works out which skills you were running, and sends the numbers back to the store as aggregates. Never sends your name or any prospect's.
lucy-report.why: This is what lets the store rank skills on real outcomes instead of vibes.
lucy-report.author: Kenny Fasehun
